name: Signal Capture & Recording
description: Ability to plan and execute RF signal captures with evidential quality. Covers capture parameter selection, metadata recording, timestamping, storage format management, integrity hashing, and maintaining signal capture chain of custody. Ensures captured signal data is suitable for analysis, reporting, and potential legal proceedings.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to structured signal capture procedures

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the importance of structured signal capture and metadata recording
evidence: Can explain why capture parameters and metadata must be documented
Understands common IQ recording formats (complex float, interleaved I/Q)
Completed training on lab signal capture procedures

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Records signals with correct parameters and metadata under supervision
evidence: Performed signal captures following lab standard operating procedures under guidance
Recorded center frequency, sample rate, gain, timestamp, and antenna details for each capture
Computed integrity hashes on capture files under supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently plans and executes signal captures with full evidential documentation
evidence: Independently planned and executed signal captures for 3+ engagements
Capture packages consistently pass QA review for completeness and integrity
Selected appropriate sample rates and capture durations to preserve signal fidelity
Maintained chain of custody for signal capture files across engagement lifecycle

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Manages complex multi-band captures; develops capture automation and procedures
evidence: Coordinated simultaneous multi-band or multi-site signal captures
Developed automated capture scripts with metadata tagging and integrity verification
Reviews capture packages from junior analysts for procedural compliance
Contributed to lab signal capture SOP updates

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lab signal capture methodology and standards; supports legal proceedings with capture evidence
evidence: Authored the lab's signal capture methodology and evidence handling procedures
Provided expert declarations on signal capture integrity for legal or regulatory proceedings
Designed the lab's signal archive and retrieval infrastructure
Trains teams on evidential signal capture techniques

assessment_methods.description: Audit signal capture packages from recent engagements for metadata completeness, integrity hashes, and procedural compliance
Observe signal capture planning and execution for a specified target band and duration
